register.labelZh: FOLLOW 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: follow on 可以表示一條問題、一堂課、一個章節或一件事自然承接前面的內容。；follow through 可以描述球員擊球、踢球或投球後需要繼續完成的重要動作。；follow through 可以區分只是說會做某事,以及真正把事情貫徹完成。；follow up 可以表示再次聯絡某人、查看進度或採取另一項有用的行動。
register.summaryEn: Follow on helps you show that a question, lesson, chapter or event continues naturally from something earlier. Follow through describes the important movement that continues after a player hits, kicks or throws a ball. Follow through can distinguish between merely saying that something will be done and actually completing it. Follow up helps you talk about contacting someone again, checking progress or taking another useful step.
contextsZh: 自然連接問題、構思和事件

contextsEn: Connect questions, ideas and events naturally
Show whether someone really completes a promise or plan
Describe action taken after a letter, meeting or request

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間、動作和結果。；以 from 或 with 開始的部分提供額外資料,並非每次都必須出現。核心表達仍然是 follow on、follow through 和 follow up。；當 it、him、her 或 them 直接放在 FOLLOW 後面時,請按照以上例子使用。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time, action and result. Phrases beginning with from or with provide extra information. They are not always part of the core expression: follow on follow on from the answer follow through follow through with the plan follow up follow the email up with a phone call When it, him, her or them comes directly after FOLLOW, place it as shown: follow it through follow it up with a phone call
